hook: On-chip resistive loads reset transmon qubits in about 48 ns without exposing them to warm wiring.
summary: Dissipation units, resonators coupled to resistors on the chip, reset several transmons and clear leakage out of the third level. A 400 ns pulse leaves 0.29% and 0.67% residual excited population from the two starting states. Results come from a small multi-qubit device and are not yet tested inside full error-correction cycles.
title: Implementing rapid reset of superconducting qubits with on-chip dissipation
